description: Registry of manual adjustments applied to final data

adjustments.description: Restrict K to productive sectors K* by excluding financial-sector capital
adjustments.result: K* adjustment increases r* by 2.5-7.9% (average +5.7%). Financial sector capital grows from 2.4% to 7.3% of total over 1948-1989. First approximation using Table 4.1 Lines 1 vs 33.

adjustments.description: Replace constant VA*/W=1.238 with year-varying ec_u/ec_p ratio for extension period
adjustments.result: ec_u/ec_p approximately 1.0 throughout — confirms book assumption was reasonable. Adjusted files in data/adjusted-final-data/. All 5 benchmark years match within tolerance.
